decision.summary: A sharp multi-axis negative excursion occurs around indices 615–625: U drops ~−1.6 MAD (to −2.67), E ~−1.0 MAD, N ~−0.7 MAD. U rebounds sharply by 630, but E and N do not fully recover within the allowed context (up to 699), leaving the offset status uncertain. No confirmed return edge observed on E or N; missing data at 626–629 and sparse sampling hinder definitive pairing of onset and return.

U recovers sharply by index 630 to ~−0.37, while E and N remain depressed (E ~−1.48, N ~5.17) — asymmetric recovery suggests incomplete return on E/N.
